donor.name: Kokkaras HK Control Panel
donor.note: The live kokkaras.com file is mutable and changed after capture. Never substitute the live URL for this pinned uploaded revision.

stage_start_protocol: Locate the donor in ChatGPT File Library by exact title/file id and confirm the pinned version/source anchors.
Use donor code as primary source for existing mechanics: endpoints, fields, ordering, calculations, guards and state behavior.
Then read the current implementation baseline only to understand integration and preserve working code.
Then read only the requested stage in docs/HK_MASTER_ROADMAP.md.
Do not infer donor mechanics from chat memory, screenshots, roadmap prose or old HK versions.
If the exact donor cannot be located, stop implementation and report DONOR SOURCE NOT FOUND instead of guessing.
source_priority: Real game API/definitions when implementing mechanics absent from donor

command_semantics.начни этап N: Execute the mandatory stage_start_protocol, then perform only stage N.
command_semantics.продолжи этап N: Re-run the mandatory source preflight, inspect current baseline/live state, then continue only stage N.
